angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 75,483,450 km at 1619.80 pc = 0.62 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, WZ Sgr: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1619.8 +/- 47 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1619.8 +/- 47 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.5742 +/- 0.0277 mas (same row, RUWE 0.94), 20.7 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 108.5 +/- 3.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, WZ Sgr: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 108.5 +/- 3.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 75,483,450 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4875 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 266, Name='WZ Sgr', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4875 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 266, Name='WZ Sgr', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4875 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.22 from 2024A&A...690A.246T, the median of its 2 spectra; the 13 published values span log g 0.4 to 1.85, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.3% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...690A.246T)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* WZ Sgr: spectral type F7(III) (1988MSS...C04....0H)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, V* WZ Sgr: projected rotation speed 25 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
